```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
install.packages("geosphere")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(geosphere)
```

```{r}
coordinate <- read.csv("../input/Sites_coordinate_data.csv")
```

```{r}
CP2 <- coordinate %>%
  filter(Pop == "CP2") %>%
  select(Longitude, Latitude)

coordinate <- coordinate %>%
  mutate (
    distance_km = distHaversine(
      cbind(Longitude, Latitude),
      c(CP2$Longitude, CP2$Latitude)
    )/1000
  )
coordinate
```

```{r}
coordinate <- coordinate %>%
  select(c("Pop", "Elev_m", "Elev_class", "distance_km"))
write_csv(coordinate, "../output/CP2_Y1_sites_w_distance_km.csv")
```
